report.methodologyBody: He mea whakahiatohia tēnei pūrongo e TikHub Analytics Studio mai i ngā API tūmatanui o te tūāpapa me te TikHub DataSet. Ka kohia ngā inenga i te wā e whakaputaina ana te pūrongo, ā, ka rerekē pea i te mea ka tipu haere ngā ihirangi taketake. Ko ngā wāhanga e hāngai ana ki te AI (ngā pakarutanga huaketo, te tango akiaki) ka whakaputaina e te LLM whai-tirohanga kua whirihorahia, ā, me pēnei he whakaaro tātari kaua e pēnei he pono-tūturu.
report.disclaimerBody: Ko ngā raraunga katoa nō ngā kaipupuri mana taketake, ā, he mea whakaputa anō ki konei mō ngā take tātari anake. Kāore a TikHub Analytics Studio e tuku pūtāhui mō te oti, te tika rānei, ā, kāore e kawe i te taunahatanga mō ngā whakatau i mahia i runga i tēnei pūrongo. Ka rāhuitia te tohatoha ki waho o te kaiwhiwhi i whakaarohia.
